findings.validation: 8 targeted cases passed: short, long, 1D and scalar Q under n_threads=1 and 2; no standardization entered.

findings.status: Hotspots agent moved _GemmWorkspace construction/BLAS resolution before threadpool_limits; source order verified.
findings.validation: Ordering and worker-failure tests added by hotspots; this reviewer did not execute those tests.

review.review_conclusion: No additional actionable blocker found in reviewed valid-input paths. Worker outputs partition by disjoint sample rows; complete SNP reductions stay in BLAS; model columns preserve Gauss-Seidel order; ExitStack waits for workers before restoring BLAS and Numba controls; absent threadpoolctl selects existing serial GEMMs.
review.memory_boundary: Prepared decoding removes float64 variant tiles and retains 8*m*q projection bytes. Initial preparation uses 8*(n+q) explicit scratch per active worker. Returned output blocks, full int8 input, optional cache, final prediction parent blocks and runtime/BLAS allocations remain. GEMM adds n*P*itemsize F-order work plus sub_block*P*itemsize products. Not a total-RSS bound.
